result.topic_en: Riemann derives the limiting value of a series built from the logarithm of the Dedekind eta function as r tends to 1 (q = r·alpha^m), obtaining the value (m,n)πi/(6n), and sketches why the series converges and is continuous at r = 1.

methods.what: Logarithm of Dedekind eta as product expansion with q = r α^m
Jacobi's transformation of the log-sum into a Lambert-type series
Asymptotic expansion as r→1 from the approximation theorem
Subtracting the conjugate expansion gives the limit value of the series
Pairing terms ν = sn+σ and ν=(s+1)n−σ to bound partial sums uniformly (Abel-type argument)
